seoTitle: Brand Color Mockup Previewer: See a Palette on UI and Poster
metaDescription: Assign colours to primary, accent, background, surface and text, then preview them on a web page, app card and poster. Free, local.
intro: Previews your palette roles on fixed sample layouts and lists the contrast of the main text and accent pairs.
why:
A palette looks different in use than in a row of swatches. Give each role a colour and see a nav bar, hero, buttons, cards, an app screen and a poster use it. Button text colour is chosen for the better contrast on the fill.

The layouts are fixed examples for judging balance, not templates. Contrast figures use the WCAG 2 ratio, and low values are marked for review.
howTo: Enter one role per line: primary, accent, background, text and optionally surface.
Review the previews and the contrast list.

faq.a: primary, accent, background and text. Surface is optional.

faq.q: Can I add a custom layout?

faq.a: It sits in a frame and wraps cards when narrow.
Text on background, text on surface, primary on background and accent on background.
